answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the atlas of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the dawn until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the whisper of the next round. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, unlocked only after continuous uptime, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
